title: Run basic keyword search within a selected facet and browse results
description: Verifies an authenticated user can select a facet, run a FIND keyword search, and see results that remain usable when sorting and paginating.

steps.description: Navigate to /login.html
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to open the search page
Select a category from the sidebar
Select the FIND operator in the search type control
Fill a keyword into the main search input
Submit the search
Sort the results by a column header
Go to the next page of results using pagination controls
Verify the results table is displayed with rows
Verify pagination indicates a different page of results is being shown

title: Deep-link query auto-runs and updates correctly after facet change
description: Verifies opening the search page with a URL query pre-fills and auto-runs the search, and switching facet refreshes results coherently.

steps.description: Navigate to /login.html
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /search.html?q=automation
Wait for the initial auto-triggered search to finish loading results
Select a different category from the sidebar
Wait for results to refresh for the newly selected category
Verify the main search input is prefilled with the URL query value
Verify the results table is displayed for the selected category

title: Apply facet filter row and see results update
description: Verifies a user can add a filter row for the selected facet, apply it, and see the results table update to reflect filtering.

steps.description: Navigate to /login.html
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to open the search page
Select a category from the sidebar
Fill a keyword into the main search input
Submit the search
Open the filter panel
Add a filter row
Select a filter field for the new filter row
Select a valid filter operator for the new filter row
Fill a valid filter value into the filter value field
Apply filters
Verify the UI indicates filters are applied
Verify the results table updates after filters are applied

title: Scope results by Org Unit and run search

title: Build a compound query with multiple conditions and logical operators
description: Verifies a user can use the query builder to create multiple conditions with AND/OR/NOT and run the compound search to produce results.

steps.description: Navigate to /login.html
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to open the search page
Select a category from the sidebar
Open the query builder
Add conditions until the condition counter is visible
Choose AND as the logical operator between two conditions
Choose OR as the logical operator between two conditions
Choose NOT as the logical operator for a condition
Submit the search
Verify the condition counter indicates multiple conditions are included
Verify the results table is displayed for the compound query

title: Prompt shown when searching with no facet and empty query
description: Verifies the app prevents searching with no category selected and an empty input by showing a user-facing prompt instead of results.

steps.description: Navigate to /login.html
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to open the search page
Ensure no category is selected in the sidebar
Clear the main search input
Submit the search
Verify a message prompting the user to select a category before viewing results is visible
Verify the results table is not displayed
